panels.visual: The Persian king Xerxes (tall crown, rich robe, fierce) on a throne watching Athens from a hill, his huge army arrayed
panels.caption: In 480 BC the Persian king Xerxes captured Athens.

panels.visual: Most Athenians fleeing by ship to the island of Salamis, a long line of boats on the sea at dawn
panels.caption: Most Athenians had fled to the island of Salamis.

panels.visual: Persian soldiers in scale armour in the foreground as the temples on the Acropolis burn behind them; a lone Athenian defender leaps from the wall in silhouette against the flames
panels.caption: Then the Persians burnt the temples.

panels.visual: A small green olive shoot sprouting from a burnt black stump of the sacred olive tree, a ray of light, an amazed Greek looking on
panels.caption: The next day a new shoot a forearm long had grown from the burnt olive tree.
